issues.where: bottom-right crop (x 0 to 17%, y 58 to 75%), the main creature's snout tentacles (also visible in set-B-01.png)
issues.what: the tentacles look like smooth, untextured clay or plastic tubes with faceted bends and blunt ends poking into the mud with no ripples, wet sheen, mud coating, or contact shadow
issues.fix: add organic surface detail and taper to the tentacles, coat their tips with wet mud, and add contact shadows and displaced mud or ripples where they meet the surface

issues.where: both crops, the wavy brown surface around the central creature and its whiskers (also visible in set-B-04.png)
issues.what: the fluid or mud reads as a sculpted procedural-noise mesh with stretched textures along pinched ridges, no depth or reflection, and the creature and its stiff ribbon-like whiskers sink straight into it with no wet edge, foam, or displacement
issues.fix: replace the uniform noise mesh with a physically grounded wet mud or liquid surface with real reflections and depth, break up the whiskers with organic thickness and wetness, and add a wet rim, meniscus, and displaced mud where the body and whiskers enter

issues.where: left crop (x 42 to 58%, y 58 to 75%), the main creature's legs and the liquid between them (also visible in set-B-01.png around the legs and foreground submerged creature)
issues.what: the legs and submerged body cut cleanly into the reddish-brown liquid as hard mesh intersections with no meniscus, foam, ripples, or wet sheen on the hide, and the fluid between the legs is a flat matte brown with no depth or reflection
issues.fix: add sky and body reflections and depth attenuation to the liquid, build a wet darkened zone and clinging mud on the lower hide, and add ripples, meniscus, and foam at every contact line

issues.where: both crops, the foreground ground and the smaller creature's feet in the right crop (x 83 to 100%, y 58 to 75%)
issues.what: the close foreground terrain has soft, stretched, low-resolution procedural shading on smooth geometry, and the smaller animal's feet lack crisp contact shadows and show a faint pale ghosted edge against the ground
issues.fix: add high-resolution micro-geometry and fine grit, pebbles, and wet mud detail to the foreground terrain, and ground the smaller creature's feet with proper ambient occlusion, contact shadows, and displaced mud

issues.what: the pale mound reads as a soft, blobby procedural-noise sculpt like clay or foam rather than real salt crust or rock
issues.fix: give the foreground crust crisp crystalline or rocky micro-detail, varied roughness, and sharper fracture edges

issues.where: top-left crop (x 0 to 17%, y 25 to 42%), the tall plant trunks and salt flats (also visible in set-B-01.png)
issues.what: the trunks are smooth uniform cylinders with a simple repeated ring texture and no grounded roots, and the pale salt-crust lines on the reddish flats look like soft procedural strokes
issues.fix: add irregular taper, bark relief, and grounded mud-coated bases to the stems, and sharpen the salt crust with fine crystalline edges and wet margins

issues.where: bottom-right crop (x 0 to 17%, y 58 to 75%), the foreground mud ridge
issues.what: the close ground shows a flat, mottled procedural shader transition with visibly stretched texture across the ridge
issues.fix: fix UV or triplanar projection to eliminate stretching and layer real sediment, wet specular variation, and fine surface relief

issues.where: right crop (x 83 to 100%, y 58 to 75%), top-center and lower-left of the brown wavy surface
issues.what: small stray white V-shaped flecks sit unnaturally on the procedural surface
issues.fix: remove the stray white particle or geometry artifacts from the mud surface
